body.text: Security regression card for the AdaptiveBase64 decode hardening. The backgroundImage is a deliberately malformed base64 data-URI (bad padding, invalid characters). The hardened AdaptiveBase64Util::Decode must reject it and return empty, so the card still renders (without a background) and the app never crashes or corrupts memory.
Expected: card renders body text; decoder returns empty for the malformed data-URI; no crash.
